description: Use this when the guest wants to know whether a room, table or ticket is free before sending a request. Answers available, unavailable or unknown. Unknown means the venue keeps no calendar with ATAbooking: the guest can still send_lead and the venue answers. Don't use this to hold anything: nothing is reserved.
